__doc__: Ordered gesture combos. A combo fires when its 'pattern' gestures happen in order within 'window' seconds. 'action' is takeoff, land, cycle_mode, speed_up, speed_down, spin360, return_home, estop, orbit, fly_north/south/east/west, or fly_pointed (dash toward where the fingers point at completion; left/right -> east/west, anything else -> north). While combos are configured, single-gesture commands that appear in a pattern are held back 'single_delay' seconds and cancelled if the combo lands. Combos are OFF right now.
